name: Senator Vest
bio: A dispatch printed in January 1885 reported that Senator Vest had laid charges of fraud in the leasing of Indian lands to cattlemen before the Senate committee on Indian affairs. The Cow Boy attacked him and Senator Cockrell that month as hypocrites for opposing Dakota's admission on partisan grounds.
